provenance: Fresh adversarial correspondence review on 2026-11-01. Read the immutable bundle unit, required exact Rust/test selections, review policy, and listed supporting context. Independently traced error and boundary cases; did not reuse earlier positive conclusions. Rust best-practice skill and v2/AGENTS.md were consulted.
rationale: Inventory::add_unit retains raw authored units, exact named selections, cited-file context, and recursively used units. Inventory::inputs adds the policy, configuration, tooling source/tests, Lean fixtures, and theme JavaScript/CSS; Lean-backed packets additionally retain the local Lean source tree. validate_bundle_against derives this expected input set anew and compares key, path, content, and hash, rather than trusting the supplied manifest. Thus a full source file cannot replace a required exact selection. The adversarial tests remove or substitute selections, alter fixtures/theme assets, and rehash reduced packets; the expected inventory still detects those changes. Extra inputs are separately re-resolved as current project files. These checks establish snapshot identity and required coverage, not the semantic conclusion or authenticity of a review.
limitations: This is a source and test-body correspondence review. It does not claim that the reviewed test suite, Lean compiler, browser, or configured command profiles were executed by this reviewer. Named context inputs were consulted for the relevant helpers, fixture declarations, or presentation rules; unrelated declarations in conservative file snapshots are not asserted to have been fully reviewed.
